related_questions.question: How much is the UK visa fee in the USA?

text_blocks.snippet: The cost of a UK visa in the USA varies depending on the type of visa. For a Standard Visitor visa, the fee is currently £127 (approximately $178 USD) for up to 6 months, according to GOV.UK. Other visa types, such as those for family, work, or study, will have different fees. You can find the specific fees for different UK visa types on the UK Visas and Immigration website.
Here's a breakdown of some common visa types and their associated costs in USD:

list.snippet: Standard Visitor visa (up to 6 months): $178
Longer-term Standard Visitor visa (up to 2 years): $665
Longer-term Standard Visitor visa (up to 5 years): $1187
Longer-term Standard Visitor visa (up to 10 years): $1483
Visiting academic (more than 6 months up to 12 months): $308
Marriage visitor visa: $178
Visitor in Transit visa: $98
Tier 1 Investor visa (main applicant and dependants): $2800
Family visa - Joining your partner: $2713

text_blocks.snippet: For the most accurate and up-to-date information, it's best to consult the official UK Visas and Immigration website.

related_questions.question: How to apply for an UK visa in the USA?

text_blocks.snippet: To apply for a UK visa from the USA, you'll need to complete the online application form, pay the required fee, and schedule a biometrics appointment at a designated center. The process involves attending the appointment to provide fingerprints and a photograph, and then potentially submitting your application and supporting documents.
snippet_highlighted_words: complete the online application form, pay the required fee, and schedule a biometrics appointment at a designated center

list.snippet: Begin by completing the online visa application form on the UK Visas and Immigration (GOV.UK) website, according to VFS Global.
Pay the applicable visa application fee online as part of the application process.
After completing the online application, you'll be redirected to VFS Global to book your biometrics appointment.
From 15 July 2025, you will only be able to schedule appointments at a UK Visa Application Centre (VAC).
You'll need to attend this appointment to provide your fingerprints and photograph (biometric information).
When attending the appointment, bring your valid passport and a copy of your appointment confirmation.
You'll need to attend your appointment on the scheduled date and time.
If you uploaded your supporting documents online, you do not need to mail them.
If you didn't upload documents online, you may need to mail your application form, passport, and supporting documents (including a stamped biometrics confirmation page) to the designated address.
Follow the instructions provided by VFS Global regarding document submission.
Ensure you meet the eligibility requirements for your chosen visa type.
Gather all necessary supporting documents, such as proof of funds and evidence of your purpose for visiting the UK.
Check processing times, as they can vary.
Standard Visitor Visa: For tourism, business visits, or short stays.
Family visa: For joining family members who are British citizens or settled in the UK.
Student visa: For studying in the UK.
Other visa types: There are many other visa categories for various purposes. Refer to GOV.UK for details.

related_questions.question: How long does it take to get an UK visa from the USA?

text_blocks.snippet: For most UK visa applications from the USA, the standard processing time is typically around 3 weeks. However, this can vary depending on the specific type of visa, the time of year, and the individual circumstances of the application.

list.title: Standard Processing:
list.snippet: The general processing time for most UK visas from the USA is approximately 3 weeks.

list.title: Priority Service:
list.snippet: For those needing a faster decision, the Priority Visa service is available, which can provide a decision within 5 working days for some applications, or within 30 working days for Family visas.

list.title: Super Priority Service:
list.snippet: The Super Priority Service, where available, can offer a decision by the end of the next working day.

list.title: Factors Affecting Processing Time:
list.snippet: The specific visa type, the volume of applications, and individual circumstances can influence the overall processing time.

list.title: Applying From Outside the UK:
list.snippet: For applications from outside the UK, including those from the USA, the standard processing time is typically 3 weeks.

list.title: Applying From Within the UK:
list.snippet: If you are applying from within the UK, the processing time can be longer, with the standard being 8 weeks.
